title: Lock Call Bonus: The Rocket Ship
blurb: Matthew on the day a president un-fired a CEO, with the gang cutting in.
kind: bonus: Matthew's live voice (his own recording) with the cast; not made by the daily render

lines.text: Six days. That is how long a corporate board's spine lasts in America now. Six days.

This is Matthew Hagan. I own the place, and before the gang gets the picks in, I need two minutes. On November seventeenth, the board of Nvidia said in writing that it did not intend to bring back its CEO. He had resigned in scandal. Congress wants him under oath. California is investigating. The SEC is reportedly looking at the books.
This morning, the board brought him back unanimously, and they told us why. Their words: they received input from senior levels of the United States government.
Input. Honey, that's what my landlord calls it too.

The president says he did it himself, admitted it. Says he convinced them. And his reason, and I'm quoting the President of the United States: he's got other chips in his brain that nobody else knows about.
I'm sorry. Is that... a legal standard?
Young man, I marched for equal protection of the laws. Nobody told me there was a rocket ship exemption.

Rocket ship. That is his other quote. The stock was a rocket ship going the wrong direction, and now it's going the right direction. It went up about thirty percent today, Nvidia stock, and here is the part where it stops being funny. The president's own disclosure, released four days ago, shows that he bought more Nvidia stock. It's up to one point six million dollars in August, he bought.
So? The man's a genius. I bought the dip too.
With what, Edwin?
...Confidence.

The White House says a bank runs his portfolio, and he can't touch it. Okay, sure. Did he buy the dip? I don't know. Nobody knows, but that's the point. In a country with rules, you would not have to wonder this. A Republican senator read the board's line about no national security risk, and he asked, based on what? A Yale professor called it a serious erosion of capitalism. I'll go further, and this part's my opinion. When a president with fascist instincts picks which billionaire gets resurrected and the market throws a parade, that is not a market. That is a banana republic with better graphics.
Get right with the president, and you rise on the third day. Everybody else gets the law.
Amen. Regrettably.
That's my time. Leslie, Brett, please give these people something honest. Give them the picks.
Thank you, boss. Unlike Nvidia's board, we post our record every single day.
And nobody from the government calls to fix Edwin's.
Picks are back tomorrow morning!
Eight A M at hardwood bricks dot com. Twenty-one and up. If gambling's a problem, call one eight hundred GAMBLER.
Keep it mid. Keep it real.

news.item: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO on Nov 23, 2026 after 'input from senior levels of the United States government'; President Trump said he convinced the board. Trump's disclosure released Nov 19 shows Nvidia purchases of up to $1.6 million in August and up to $265,000 in September. Opinion lines are Matthew's and are said as opinion.
